column1: The v0.4.8 baseline contains **204 records**. The lossless machine-readable baseline is stored in four ordered CSV shards under `registry/records/`.

These shards are retained for auditability and exact field preservation. They are **not** a separate technical index: every record is also routed into the main device/protocol/function structure. Future records must be added to the canonical structure at the same time they are added to the machine registry.
